description.value: Spinnakers Spirits — listed on the Spinnakers website as James Bay Spirit Merchants — is a retail outlet of Victoria's iconic Spinnakers Gastro Brewpub brand, offering the brewery's craft beers, ciders, spirits, and related products for off-premises purchase in the James Bay neighbourhood. Spinnakers has been at the forefront of BC craft brewing since 1984, and this shop brings their rotating selection of traditionally crafted brews and spirits to retail customers. Cyclists seeking locally made beer or spirits to take away will find it conveniently located near the Inner Harbour.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (6 spaces) at 17m; rack at 99m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record at 435 Simcoe Street matches the 'James Bay Spirit Merchants' location listed on the Spinnakers website contact page (435 Simcoe Street #3, Victoria, BC V8V 4T3), confirming this is a standalone retail spirits/alcohol shop rather than the main Spinnakers Gastro Brewpub at 308 Catherine Street. The website provides a phone number (250-590-3515) specific to this location but contains no evidence of bike parking, washrooms, water refills, or other cyclist-focused amenities at this retail outlet. The OSM name 'Spinnakers Spirits' does not match the website's name for this location, which is 'James Bay Spirit Merchants.'
